title: How to Handle My Sassy Big Sis
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Konno, a gyaru taken in by a family, is sharp-tongued toward her younger stepbrother Tanuki and seen as cold at school. A friend suggests Tanuki 'handle' her like a manga trope, but he chooses to win her over with kindness and persistence while she faces threats from older boys and a predatory teacher (Yen Press blurb; Outerhaven review of volume 1).
life_message: Patient kindness can reach someone whose hostility hides hurt, and family means protecting each other.
